label: GOD_4 is not properly in any GENUS_1, from Every GENUS_1 has at least one differentia… and 4 more
meaning: ST I q.3 a.5 co., second proof: being is not a genus (derived by Aristotle's argument, imported), whatever God were properly in would be a genus, and it would be being; so God is in no genus properly. The Comparator config also verifies countermodels for the two Aquinas premises.
